how: The real claude 2.1.319 started directly (no SDK) by scripts/verify/drive.mjs, in an empty home and config folder, with a made-up bearer token, against a loopback stand-in for the Messages API (scripts/verify/fakes.mjs). `t` is milliseconds since the process was started. stdout_kinds lists every stdout line; stdout_selected holds the messages the specification cites (init and the answer to initialize cut to their keys).
